mainEntity.name: Which kinds of business do you work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: D2C brands, B2B companies and educational institutes. See the D2C, B2B and education pages.

mainEntity.name: What if we are a different kind of business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us what you sell and how customers find you. We will say honestly whether we are a fit, and if we are not, we will say so.

mainEntity.name: Does the approach change by industry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. What counts as a good result, which channels matter and how long a customer takes to decide all differ, so measures and funnels are set per business.
See our work for projects across these kinds of business.
It depends on scope and, for media, on ad spend, so we quote after the audit call, once we have seen your accounts.

hub.sub: We work with direct-to-consumer brands, companies that sell to other businesses, and educational institutes, and shape each engagement around how that business actually grows.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: Industry-specific marketing is the work of adapting strategy, channels and measures to how a particular kind of business actually wins customers.
answer.hl: how a particular kind of business actually wins customers
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) works with D2C brands, B2B companies and educational institutes, and treats each as its own kind of growth problem.

points.title: D2C brands
points.text: Ads, store, creative and retention read against margin.

points.title: B2B companies
points.text: Lead generation judged on fit, not form fills.

leaks.lede: Each kind of business loses customers in a different place. Below is what is often done, and what we do instead.

stages.breaks: Judging every channel on ROAS alone.
stages.why: A ROAS number ignores product cost, shipping and returns, so a campaign can look healthy while its orders lose money.
stages.does: We read performance against contribution margin, and connect ads, store speed, creative and retention so the whole journey works.

stages.why: Sales cycles are long and buyer groups are small, so a few good leads matter more than many poor ones, and a form fill says little about fit.
stages.does: We connect paid media, a clear website and your CRM, and pass lead stages back to the ad platforms so campaigns learn what a good lead is.

stages.why: Admissions depend on the follow-up, on the reputation students and parents find, and on the reminders between an enquiry and an enrolment.
stages.does: We build lead generation with CRM and Meta CAPI, manage reviews and reputation, and run retention funnels through the admissions cycle.

numbers.note: Agreed with you before work starts.

cards.d: What an order leaves once product, shipping, returns and ads are paid.
Enquiries that fit your buyer, not every form fill.
What each rupee produced, read alongside your total results.
Paid media across Meta, Google, Amazon and quick commerce, read against profit.
Paid media and follow-up funnels connected to your CRM and Meta CAPI.
WhatsApp, email and loyalty funnels that bring buyers back.
